articles.title: How Pro Football Became America’s National Obsession
articles.mainIdea: How Pro Football Became America’s National Obsession
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: How Pro Football Became America’s National Obsession. It’s actually not a bad line of questioning for us to consider: What is it with our National Football League obsession—especially the televised version of it? How and why did pro football become such an integral part of the American experience? “People like that football is unscripted entertainment with tradition,” says Jerry Jones, the omnipresent owner of the Dallas Cowboys. Related tickers mentioned: AMZN, GOOG, NFLX.

articles.title: Reliable, Multi-Gigabit Internet from Xfinity Now Available to New Communities Across Carbon, Luzerne, and Schuylkill Counties in Pennsylvania
articles.mainIdea: Reliable, Multi-Gigabit Internet from Xfinity Now Available to New Communities Across Carbon, Luzerne, and Schuylkill Counties in Pennsylvania
articles.summary: Business Wire: Reliable, Multi-Gigabit Internet from Xfinity Now Available to New Communities Across Carbon, Luzerne, and Schuylkill Counties in Pennsylvania. PITTSBURGH, February 03, 2026--Comcast has completed a significant network expansion in Northeastern Pennsylvania, delivering reliable, high-speed, symmetrical Internet to more than 8,800 homes and businesses across Carbon, Luzerne, and Schuylkill counties. This expansion has brought multi-gigabit Internet, mobile, entertainment, and security services from Xfinity and Comcast Business to these areas for the first time.
